notes.title: Patching up the big Update. / Official Discord & Twitter
notes.notes:
Hello. I just wanted to let you know what was in the latest update (yesterday). 
After adding all this new stuff in the game, some bugs came with that. For example whenever you would go prone underneath a tent, its collision would mess with your character and you would fly on top of the Tent. You were also able to pick up an AR4 even when you already had one. Doing that would mess with your pistol, and it looked as if your pistol was stuck into an AR4. These too and about 10-12 more bugs were fixed yesterday. I expect there to be a few more that I couldn't find when testing the game by myself, so I am asking for your help on this one. Please report any bugs directly on discord or on my twitter. PS The first objective (the backpack) now also saves your game)
Cheers.

Discord: https://discord.gg/TF7PVMSBXr
Twitter: https://twitter.com/lamdaprojects

Support us on IndieGoGo: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/eminus-tactical-fps/x/25868759#/

notes.title: Major Update on the way!
notes.notes:
Hola my friends. The next update is going to take a bit longer but there are quiet a few good reasons for it. Thanks to the people that support Eminus already, I was able to buy some assets that will bring the game to a whole new level. The whole character movement will become smoother and more realistic. There is a bunch of new guns & attachments that you will be able to find in the game. Prone system, and a whole new Main Menu. Here are some screenshots of what you should expect. Peace.

notes.title: Kind of a cool update 23th
notes.notes:
Hey hey, I've added and changed a few things that I believe will give you a kinda different & improved experience.

Let's start with what has changed:

 Getting shot at will now feel more realistic, since the AI fires faster but has a bit less accuracy. 
 You are now also less likely to get shot while sprinting.
 I added about 8 new sound effects for bullets that hit you and bullets that land near you. This adds to the feeling of "panic" when you get shot at. 
 I changed and added some sounds you make when a bullet hits you, so there is a variety of sounds now.


What's new:

 Aiming is now a smooth transition between the eye- and weapon camera, though I am still working on making the returning camera smooth as well.
 You can now kill the enemies quietly by pressing "G".


I hope you like the new stuff, feel free to report bugs and give feedback in the discussions.
Cheers

notes.title: Update 8th of February
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

After receiving plenty of feedback about the difficulty of the game, I decided to drop a small update changing a few things.



 Stationary AI Guards are now firing about 0.6 seconds slower.
 All AI guards have now 45% accuracy instead of the previous 50%.
 The game saves once after you complete the second objective.
 

PS. Saving the game only stores: Location, Killed AIs and the Sniper Rifle if it is already picked up.
I will work on a more advanced saving system and update again when it's.

I appreciate your feedback, 
Cheers
